title: PK Document Tracking System - Process Flow

pages.title: Sign in and find documents
pages.summary: Sign in, find a document and use the actions your account allows.

steps.text: Sign in with the account your Administrator provided.
If asked, replace your temporary password before continuing.
Open Overview, Hardcopy Documents, Softcopy Documents or External Documents.
Use folders, Search and filters. Open View Details to read the full record.
Show the records and actions allowed for this account.
Use Download or Print when available for the current file. External Documents offer Download.

notes: Viewing, editing, approving and using files each require permission.
Hardcopy records track physical documents. Softcopy and External Documents can include controlled files.

pages.title: Register or edit a hardcopy
pages.summary: An authorized holder registers or edits a physical document. Saving updates the record immediately.

steps.text: Open Hardcopy Documents. Choose Add New Hardcopy Document, or Edit an active record.
Enter Document Title. Choose Area, Specific, optional Asset and Location.
Check Current Holder and retention dates. For a new record, add Reason / Notes if needed.
Choose Save Document and confirm.
Check the storage, holder and dates; save the active record and its history.

notes: Only the current holder with direct hardcopy permission, or an Administrator, can edit an active hardcopy.
Administrators may select another active holder. Other users register themselves as holder.
Register and edit hardcopies directly. New Hardcopy Create and Update requests are unavailable.

pages.title: Check storage and retention dates
pages.summary: Check where a hardcopy is kept and when its retention period ends, then arrange any follow-up.

steps.text: Open Hardcopy Documents. Use folders or Search to find the document.
Open View Details. Check Area, Specific, Asset, Location and Current Holder.
When editing, enable Track retention period. Enter Retention Start and Retention End.
Show days remaining, Due today or an overdue message using office dates.
Filter by Due Today, Overdue, Due in the Next 7 Days or Due in 8-30 Days.
Review the physical document. Arrange a permitted update, transfer or disposal if needed.

notes: Both retention dates are required when tracking is enabled. Retention End must be on or after Retention Start.
Reminders cover visible active hardcopies whose retention end date has arrived. Retention never triggers automatic disposal.
Several hardcopy documents may share one Location. The displayed Location sequence belongs to that storage place.

pages.title: Create or revise a softcopy directly
pages.summary: An authorized controller creates a softcopy or makes a revision available immediately.

steps.text: Open Softcopy Documents. Choose Add New Softcopy Document, or Edit an active record.
Choose Create Softcopy or Revise Softcopy. Enter Subject / Reason and Proposed Document Title.
To create, choose Category. To revise, choose Existing Softcopy Document.
Check Number of Pages and attach Document File. Add Effective Date and Remarks if needed.
Choose Approve Directly and confirm.
Create the active document or publish its next revision with the replacement file.

notes: The system generates a new document number. Need Series Number? allows an existing category number with a unique series.
A file is required: PDF, TXT, PNG, JPG/JPEG, DOCX or XLSX, up to 15 MB. A blank direct Effective Date uses the approval date.
Revision keeps the document number, series and category. Softcopy cancellation is unavailable; authorized disposal is separate.

pages.title: Create or revise external documents directly
pages.summary: An authorized controller records a document from outside the organization and makes its file available.

steps.text: Open External Documents. Choose Add New External Document, or Edit an active record.
Enter Document Title, choose Category and add Description if needed.
Choose Attach Files and select up to 20 PDF, image, scan or supported document files. For a revision, these files become the replacement attachments.
Choose Save Directly and confirm.
Create an active record at revision 00, or publish the next revision and its replacement file.

notes: External Documents use External Categories and do not use retention dates.
Attach up to 20 PDF, TXT, PNG, JPG/JPEG, DOCX or XLSX files, up to 15 MB each. Description may contain up to 2,000 characters.
Revising a record or using its file requires the appropriate permission and document access.

pages.title: Request a new document or revision
pages.summary: Default review order: Requester's leader > Plant Manager > Document Control Officer. Final approval creates the document or publishes its revision.

steps.text: Open My Requests. Choose Softcopy Request or External Document Request, then New Request.
Choose Create or Revise. Enter Subject / Reason, the proposed title and other requested details.
For creation, choose Category. For revision, choose the existing document. Attach the required file and add optional Remarks.
Choose Save Draft and confirm. Review it, then Submit and confirm.
Review in the displayed order. At each step, choose Approve, Return or Reject and confirm.
Final approval creates an Active record and file at revision 00, or publishes the next revision and file. Request: Completed.

notes: First-step Return: requester corrects and resubmits (Returned). Later Return: previous approver reviews again (Submitted).
Reject ends the request as Rejected. No new record or revision is applied. The request cannot be resubmitted.
Supplied default shown. Check Approval Process Timeline; resubmission keeps the original route.
Softcopy creation: Number of Pages and optional series. External: External Create Request or External Revised Request; Description.
PDF, TXT, PNG, JPG/JPEG, DOCX or XLSX; up to 15 MB. Pending files are not current. Creation numbers are assigned at approval.

pages.title: Save, submit or remove your draft
pages.summary: Save and review your proposal, then submit it for approval. Use the linked decision example for your request type.

steps.text: Open the matching My Requests tab. Choose New Request and complete the form.
Choose Save Draft and confirm. Use Edit to correct your Draft or Returned request.
Open View Details. Check the proposal and use Review File when available.
When ready, choose Submit and confirm. Check Approval Process Timeline for the assigned reviewers.
Check permission, active choices and files. Mark Submitted and notify the first approver.
Apply changes only after final approval. A transfer stays Approved until Dispatch and Accept complete it.

notes: Only the requester can edit their Draft or Returned request. Submitted and resubmitted requests keep the original route.
First-step Return: requester corrects and resubmits (Returned). Later Return: previous approver reviews again (Submitted).
Reject ends approval as Rejected without applying the change. That request cannot be resubmitted.
A Submitted Access, Assignment or Transfer request blocks another of these for the same requester and document.
Only the requester can Cancel a Draft. Delete permanently removes an eligible Cancelled draft only if never submitted.

Only the assigned user or role can decide; Administrator status gives no bypass.

Requester corrects and resubmits. Status: Returned until resubmission.
Requester's leader reviews again. Status stays Submitted.
Plant Manager reviews again. Status stays Submitted.
Status: Rejected. The approval route ends.
Not applied. The current approved file and revision stay unchanged.
Read the decision and remarks. This request cannot be resubmitted.

notes: This sample uses the supplied default. Check your Approval Process Timeline. Resubmission keeps the original route.
Revision keeps the document number, category and series. The approved replacement becomes the current file.

pages.title: External creation: approve, return or reject
pages.summary: Default workflow example: External Document Request (External Create Request). Each reviewer can Approve, Return or Reject.

steps.text: Prepare the external creation request and Submit.
Noted By

pages.review: At each review: read the proposal, approval history and Review File when available. Choose an action, add remarks if needed and Confirm.

cases.next: Plant Manager reviews next.

Create the Active record and file at revision 00. Status: Completed.
Requester corrects and resubmits. Status: Returned until resubmission.
Requester's leader reviews again. Status stays Submitted.
Plant Manager reviews again. Status stays Submitted.
Status: Rejected. The approval route ends.
Not applied. No new external document is created.
Read the decision and remarks. This request cannot be resubmitted.

notes: This sample uses the supplied default. Check your Approval Process Timeline. Resubmission keeps the original route.
External Documents uses its own categories. The attached file becomes the current file after final approval.

pages.title: External revision: approve, return or reject
pages.summary: Default workflow example: External Document Request (External Revised Request). Each reviewer can Approve, Return or Reject.

steps.text: Prepare the external revision request and Submit.
Noted By
Plant Manager Approval
Document Control Officer

pages.review: At each review: read the proposal, approval history and Review File when available. Choose an action, add remarks if needed and Confirm.

cases.next: Plant Manager reviews next.
Document Control Officer reviews next.
Publish the next revision and replacement file. Status: Completed.
Requester corrects and resubmits. Status: Returned until resubmission.
Requester's leader reviews again. Status stays Submitted.
Plant Manager reviews again. Status stays Submitted.
Status: Rejected. The approval route ends.
Not applied. The current external file and revision stay unchanged.
Read the decision and remarks. This request cannot be resubmitted.

notes: This sample uses the supplied default. Check your Approval Process Timeline. Resubmission keeps the original route.
The approved replacement becomes the current Download file. External Documents has no separate File History action.

pages.title: Hardcopy transfer: approve, return or reject
pages.summary: Default workflow example: Hardcopy Transfer Request. Requester Confirmation is an approval step before the physical handoff.

steps.text: Prepare the transfer request and Submit.
Plant Manager  Approval
Document Control Officer Approval
Requester Confirmation

pages.review: At each review: read the proposal, approval history and Review File when available. Choose an action, add remarks if needed and Confirm.

cases.next: Document Control Officer reviews next.
Requester reviews next.
Status: Approved; handoff: For Transfer. Then Dispatch and Accept.
Requester corrects and resubmits. Status: Returned until resubmission.
Plant Manager reviews again. Status stays Submitted.
Document Control Officer reviews again. Status stays Submitted.
Status: Rejected. The approval route ends.
No handoff is created. The current holder and location stay unchanged.
Read the decision and remarks. This request cannot be resubmitted.

notes: This sample uses the supplied default. Check your Approval Process Timeline. Resubmission keeps the original route.
Only the requester can Dispatch; only the named receiver can Accept. Holder and location change after Accept.

pages.title: Document access: approve, return or reject
pages.summary: Default workflow example: Document Access Request. The requester completes the final Requester Confirmation step.

steps.text: Prepare the access request and Submit.
Plant Manager Approval
Document Control Officer
Requester Confirmation

pages.review: At each review: read the proposal, approval history and Review File when available. Choose an action, add remarks if needed and Confirm.

cases.next: Document Control Officer reviews next.
Requester reviews next.
Grant access through the approved expiry. Status: Completed.
Requester corrects and resubmits. Status: Returned until resubmission.
Plant Manager reviews again. Status stays Submitted.
Document Control Officer reviews again. Status stays Submitted.
Status: Rejected. The approval route ends.
No new access is granted. Existing permissions stay unchanged.
Read the decision and remarks. This request cannot be resubmitted.

notes: This sample uses the supplied default. Check your Approval Process Timeline. Resubmission keeps the original route.
Access is for the requester. The expiry must still be valid at final approval; document holder and location stay unchanged.

pages.title: Document assignment: approve, return or reject
pages.summary: Default workflow example: Document Assignment Request. The final Requester Approval step is assigned to the requester's leader.

steps.text: Prepare the assignment request and Submit.
Plant Manager Approval
Document Control Officer
Requester Approval

pages.review: At each review: read the proposal, approval history and Review File when available. Choose an action, add remarks if needed and Confirm.

cases.next: Document Control Officer reviews next.
Requester's leader reviews next.
Assign the softcopy or hardcopy to the requester. Status: Completed.
Requester corrects and resubmits. Status: Returned until resubmission.
Plant Manager reviews again. Status stays Submitted.
Document Control Officer reviews again. Status stays Submitted.
Status: Rejected. The approval route ends.
No new assignment or hardcopy holder change is applied.
Read the decision and remarks. This request cannot be resubmitted.

notes: This sample uses the supplied default. Check your Approval Process Timeline. Resubmission keeps the original route.
Softcopy assignment adds the requester as assignee. Hardcopy assignment changes the holder, keeps Location and records no physical handoff.

Plant Manager Approval
Document Control Officer
Requester Confirmation

cases.next: Document Control Officer reviews next.
Requester reviews next.
Mark the document Disposed and record it. Request status: Completed.
Requester corrects and resubmits. Status: Returned until resubmission.
Plant Manager reviews again. Status stays Submitted.
Document Control Officer reviews again. Status stays Submitted.
Status: Rejected. The approval route ends.
No disposal is applied. The document stays unchanged.
Read the decision and remarks. This request cannot be resubmitted.

notes: This sample uses the supplied default. Check your Approval Process Timeline. Resubmission keeps the original route.
Disposal requests cover Hardcopy and External Documents. Hardcopy disposal clears Location; active document grants are revoked.

pages.title: Request and approve a hardcopy transfer
pages.summary: Default review order: Plant Manager > Document Control Officer > Requester account (Requester Confirmation). Approval prepares the physical handoff.

steps.text: Open My Requests > Hardcopy Transfer Request. Choose New Request.
Choose Hardcopy Document. Check Original Places and Holder against the current record.
Choose Destination Area, Specific, optional Asset and a different Location.
Choose Receiving User. Enter Request Subject and optional Remarks, then Save Draft and Submit.
Choose Approve, Return or Reject in the displayed order. Requester account completes Requester Confirmation in My Tasks.
After final approval: request Approved; handoff For Transfer. Holder and location stay unchanged until Accept.

notes: First-step Return: requester corrects and resubmits (Returned). Later Return: previous approver reviews again (Submitted).
Reject ends approval as Rejected with no handoff or holder change. The request cannot be resubmitted.
Source, destination and receiver must be active and allowed. Destination needs Area, Specific and Location; Asset is optional.
The requester may differ from Current Holder. Only the original requester can later Dispatch.
Supplied default shown. Check Approval Process Timeline; resubmission keeps the original route.

pages.title: Dispatch and receive a hardcopy
pages.summary: Default approvals first: Plant Manager > Document Control Officer > Requester account. Then the requester dispatches and the named receiver accepts.

steps.text: Open My Tasks > Hardcopy Transfer Request. Find Physical Transfer Handoffs.
For a For Transfer handoff, release the document. Choose Dispatch and confirm.
Mark In Transit. Record who dispatched the document and when.
After receiving the document, open Physical Transfer Handoffs. Choose Accept and confirm.
Check that the document and Location are active, the holder is unchanged and storage matches approval.
Make the receiver the holder and update storage. Mark the handoff Accepted and the request Completed.

notes: Only the original requester can Dispatch. Only the named receiving user can Accept an In Transit handoff.
A changed holder, unavailable Location or changed approved storage path blocks acceptance; the handoff stays unchanged.
A holder change revokes the previous holder's personal hardcopy access grants. Global permissions still apply.
Before final approval: first-step Return goes to the requester (Returned); later Return goes to the previous approver (Submitted).
Reject ends approval as Rejected with no handoff. Check Approval Process Timeline; Dispatch and Accept are separate from approvals.

pages.title: Request temporary document access
pages.summary: Default review order: Plant Manager > Document Control Officer > Requester account (Requester Confirmation). Request access for yourself.

steps.text: Open My Requests > Document Access Request. Choose New Request.
Choose Softcopy or Hardcopy and its document. Check your name in Recipient / Assigned User.
Enter Subject / Reason. Set Access Expires At after today and add Remarks if needed.
Choose Save Draft, then Submit. Confirm each action.
Review in the displayed order. Choose Approve, Return or Reject; Requester account has the final confirmation.
Final approval grants access through the approved expiry date. Request: Completed. Holder and assignments stay unchanged.

notes: For yourself only; Recipient / Assigned User cannot change. Check Approval Process Timeline; resubmission keeps its route.
First-step Return: requester corrects and resubmits (Returned). Later Return: previous approver reviews again (Submitted).
Reject ends approval as Rejected with no new access. Existing permissions stay unchanged. The request cannot be resubmitted.
Expiry must still be valid at final approval. Access ends at the end of the selected date, or earlier if revoked.
Document and file permissions still apply. Seeing a document title does not grant download, print or edit rights.

pages.title: Request a document assignment
pages.summary: Default review order: Plant Manager > Document Control Officer > Requester's leader. The final step is named Requester Approval.

steps.text: Open My Requests > Document Assignment Request. Choose New Request.
Choose Softcopy or Hardcopy and its document. Check your name in Recipient / Assigned User.
Enter Subject / Reason and optional Remarks. Choose Save Draft, then Submit and confirm.
Choose Approve, Return or Reject in order. The requester's leader completes Requester Approval.
On final approval for Softcopy, add the requester as an assignee and keep existing assignees. Request: Completed.
On final approval for Hardcopy, make the requester Current Holder. Keep storage unchanged. Request: Completed.

notes: This request is for you. Authorized controllers use Document Assignments to assign others. Check Approval Process Timeline.
First-step Return: requester corrects and resubmits (Returned). Later Return: previous approver reviews again (Submitted).
Reject ends approval as Rejected. No assignment or holder change is applied. The request cannot be resubmitted.
Hardcopy assignment does not move the document or use Dispatch and Accept. Resubmission keeps the original route.
Assignment does not create temporary access. The account's document and file permissions still apply.

pages.title: Assign one document directly
pages.summary: An authorized controller adds a softcopy assignee or changes a hardcopy holder immediately.

steps.text: Open Document Assignments. Choose Hardcopy / Places or Softcopy / Categories.
Choose Assign Document. Select the active document and Assigned User.
Choose Save Assignment and confirm.
Check the active document and user, and any active hardcopy transfer.
Change the hardcopy holder or add the softcopy assignee. Keep storage unchanged.

notes: Direct assignment requires its own permission and takes effect immediately. It needs no approval, Dispatch or Accept.
Hardcopy assignment changes the recorded holder and keeps the storage place. It does not physically move the document.
Softcopy assignment keeps existing assignees. An active Hardcopy transfer blocks reassignment. File permissions still apply.

pages.title: Assign all hardcopies at a Location
pages.summary: An authorized controller gives every active hardcopy at one Location the same recorded holder.

steps.text: Open Document Assignments. Choose Hardcopy / Places.
Choose Location and Assigned User. Review the active records at that Location.
Choose Assign All and confirm.
Check the user, active records, 2,000-document limit and any active transfers.
Change the holder for every selected document. Keep each storage location unchanged.

notes: Bulk assignment includes all active hardcopies at the selected Location, up to 2,000 documents.
For Transfer or In Transit handoffs block hardcopy reassignment. Resolve the active transfer before retrying.
Direct assignment needs its own permission and no approval, Dispatch or Accept. It changes records without physically moving documents.

pages.title: Assign all softcopies in a category
pages.summary: An authorized controller adds a user to every active softcopy in the chosen category and its subcategories.

steps.text: Open Document Assignments. Choose Softcopy / Categories.
Choose Category / Subcategory and Assigned User. Review the category and its subcategories.
Choose Assign All and confirm.
Check the active user, selected records and 2,000-document limit.
Add the user to every selected document. Keep the existing assignees.

notes: The selected category and all its subcategories are included. Only active softcopies are assigned, up to 2,000 documents.
Direct assignment requires its own permission and takes effect immediately, without an approval request.
Assignment does not create a temporary personal access grant. The account's document and file permissions still apply.

pages.title: Dispose of a document directly
pages.summary: An authorized holder or controller records the method and marks the document Disposed immediately.

steps.text: Open the document register. Choose Dispose on an active record you are allowed to manage.
Choose Shred, Scratch or Other. Describe the method if you choose Other.
Confirm the direct disposal.
Check both required direct permissions, the reason and whether the document can be disposed of.
Mark Disposed. Save the method, responsible person and disposal history.

notes: Direct disposal supports all three registers and needs both direct permissions. Other requires a description of up to 250 characters.
Direct Hardcopy disposal retains Location and personal grants. Softcopy disposal retires its controlled files.
External disposal keeps stored files and revision records but blocks normal download. Retention never triggers automatic disposal.

pages.title: Request hardcopy or external disposal
pages.summary: Default review order: Plant Manager > Document Control Officer > Requester account (Requester Confirmation). Final approval applies disposal.

steps.text: Open My Requests > Disposal Request. Choose New Request.
Choose Hardcopy or External and its active document. Complete the request details.
Choose Shred, Scratch or Other. Describe Other and add Remarks if needed.
Choose Save Draft and review it, then Submit. Confirm each action.
Follow Approval Process Timeline. Choose Approve, Return or Reject; Requester account has the final confirmation.
After final approval, mark the document Disposed and the request Completed. Keep approval and disposal history.

notes: Hardcopy and External only. Softcopy disposal uses a permitted direct action. Other needs a description of up to 250 characters.
First-step Return: requester corrects and resubmits (Returned). Later Return: previous approver reviews again (Submitted).
Reject ends approval as Rejected with no disposal. The document stays unchanged. The request cannot be resubmitted.
Supplied default shown. Check Approval Process Timeline; resubmission keeps the original route.
Approved Hardcopy disposal clears Location and personal grants. External disposal keeps stored files and revision records.

pages.title: Set up storage places and categories
pages.summary: Maintain the storage places and category folders people choose when recording documents.

steps.text: Open Master Data. Choose Area, Specific, Asset Number, Location, Softcopy Category, External Category or Subsidiary Setup.
Create Area, then a Specific within it. Add optional Asset Numbers under Specific.
For Location, enter Location Name, Area and Specific. Add Asset Number and Archive Date if needed.
For a category, enter its name and folder name. Add a parent and softcopy code pattern if needed.
Save and confirm. Use Edit or Deactivate when allowed.
Check parent choices, category nesting and unique codes or sequences. Update the available choices.

notes: A Location can omit Asset Number. Its Sequence is unique within its Specific and is assigned automatically when left empty.
Softcopy Categories and External Categories are separate. Only softcopy categories define a document numbering pattern.
Deactivation removes a choice from active selection; it does not delete the existing document records.

pages.title: Manage users, roles and permissions
pages.summary: Create accounts, assign roles and choose which pages and actions each person can use.

steps.text: Open Roles & Permissions. Choose Add Role or Edit, select allowed actions, then Save Role.
Open User Management. Choose Add User or Edit and enter the account details.
Choose Primary role, Assigned roles and optional Leader. Check Active account, then Save User.
Give sign-in details securely to the intended person. Reset a temporary password when needed.
Sign in with the temporary password, then replace it as prompted.
Review Assigned Documents. Deactivate users or unused roles, or Remove an eligible role.

notes: Active roles combine a user's permissions. The Leader receives approval steps configured as Requester's leader.
A delegated administrator cannot grant permissions they do not hold or create an Administrator role assignment.
Roles still used by accounts or approval routes cannot be removed. Account and role actions each require their own permission.

pages.title: Publish an approval route
pages.summary: Choose who approves future requests and in what order. Previously submitted requests keep their recorded route.

steps.text: Open Workflow Builder. Select the request type and version.
Choose Start First Draft or Create Next Draft.
Choose Add Approval Step. Name it and select a role, person, requester's leader or requester.
Choose Save Step. Edit, reorder or Remove steps to match the process.
Choose Validate & Publish and confirm.
Publish the checked route for future submissions. Keep the route already saved for existing requests.

notes: Published versions are read-only. Create a draft to change future approvals.
Submission must resolve active approvers. A route that needs a requester's leader cannot start without an active assigned leader.
Check the published route for the actual approval order. Default route examples may change.

pages.title: Follow reminders and review past actions
pages.summary: Use notices to find work needing attention. Authorized reviewers can trace recorded actions in the audit trail.

steps.text: Check the counts beside My Requests and My Tasks. Open the matching tab.
Highlight your Draft or Returned requests, assigned approvals and physical handoff tasks.
Open a task reminder. Read the request before taking an allowed action.
Open a retention reminder. Check the hardcopy's due or overdue date.
Open Internal Audit Trail. Search or filter to find the action.
Open View Details. Check who acted, when it happened and the result.

notes: Approval Process Timeline and request history explain request decisions. Internal Audit Trail records wider system actions.
Reminders do not approve, dispatch, accept or dispose of documents; the responsible person still confirms the action.
Counts and alerts reflect the signed-in account's allowed work. Dates and times use Asia/Manila.

pages.title: Create, download or import a backup
pages.summary: Keep protected recovery copies and remove eligible older backup and log archives when needed.

steps.text: Open Backup & Restore. Check that backup setup is ready.
Choose Backup now and confirm to create a protected backup.
List the completed backup with its type, creation time and size.
Choose Download. Store the backup in a secure place.
To add an existing backup, choose Import backup. Select Backup ZIP and confirm.
Choose Clean up when appropriate. Confirm removal of eligible archives older than three months.

notes: A backup contains system records, application code and private files. Routine temporary files and existing backup archives are excluded.
The daily backup target is 5:00 PM, Asia/Manila. Automatic runs require the server scheduler to be configured and verified.
Import verifies and stores a backup; it does not restore live data. Clean up applies to eligible backup, audit and log archives.

pages.title: Restore records and private files
pages.summary: Replace current records and private files with a checked backup, then sign in and verify the result.

steps.text: Open Backup & Restore. Choose Restore system data.
Choose Backup to restore. Enter Your password and type RESTORE.
Choose Restore selected backup. Confirm replacement of current records and private files.
Check the backup and permission. Save a recovery backup before replacing current data.
Pause normal use, restore records and private files, then sign out the operator.
Sign in again. Check the restored records, attachments and everyday tasks.

notes: Plan a maintenance period: restoration replaces current records and private files with the selected backup's contents.
Enter the operator's account password. The server must also be configured to open and verify the protected archive.
The web restore does not replace application code. A system maintainer handles code recovery separately when needed.
